stories.description:
After Raynare stabbed Issei, Rias resurrected Issei and turned him into a devil. While the body of Issei did change to a devil, his soul was replaced by someone from a different world, someone whose history is buried in mystery. Someone who has the potential to become the strongest.

Well, since this is DXD fan fiction, there will be a harem, and a big one at that. Clearly.

This story will closely follow the plot with some diversion.

MC can act emotionless and can be possessive with people as well as for artifacts.  And to win, he will do anything.

---

(I posted an audiobook of this fan fiction in my Patreon.)

---

Before you read this fan fiction, you need to know something.

I have borrowed some ideas from other fan fictions.

And to enjoy the fan fiction, please shut down your logic before reading this.

---
